# Vendored third-party assets

The files in `../` are bundled, unmodified, from upstream npm releases. Full
license texts in this directory.

| File | Upstream | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mermaid.min.js` | [mermaid-js/mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) | 11.4.1 | MIT (+ bundled transitive deps under MIT / BSD / ISC / Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0) |
| `perfect-freehand.mjs` | [steveruizok/perfect-freehand](https://github.com/steveruizok/perfect-freehand) | 1.2.2 | MIT |

Both libraries' minified bundles drop their top-level license banners; the
texts here restore the attribution required by the MIT license.
